name: ALOE PROPOLIS CREME
short_desc: A rich, creamy blend of aloe vera, bee propolis and chamomile that helps maintain healthy, beautiful skin tone and texture.

name: FOREVER BEE PROPOLIS
short_desc: Food supplement made by bees and loved by humans. Forever Bee Propolis contains natural, nutritious ingredients and has protective properties.

name: FOREVER BEE POLLEN
short_desc: Forever Bee Pollen packs all the power of one of nature’s most pure superfoods into every tablet. Our formula contains pure bee pollen, combined with honey and royal jelly for a winning combination of nutrients straight from the hive!

name: FOREVER BEE HONEY
short_desc: There’s only one thing you’ll find in a bottle of Forever Bee Honey and that’s pure, natural and responsibly harvested honey. This complex nectar is not just a perfect natural sweetener, it’s good for you too!

name: FOREVER ROYAL JELLY
short_desc: Natural royal jelly is a rich, milky substance which consists of proteins, simple sugars, fatty acids and trace elements vitamin B5 and B6.
